summary: Parses and stores a driver name string from a path-like input a2. Defaults the result to -1, then normalizes a copy of the string with sub_589901, rejects it with -1 if StringArrayMatchSearch (00497f90) blacklist-matches, otherwise resolves it via StringNormalizeLookup (00495810). When the string is not a known registered key (lookup returns 0), sub_587C20 truncates it at the path separator word_5BEB48 and the extracted component is copied into a per-instance name storage slot indexed by this[1349] (this+0x1514). Returns the lookup index, or -1 on a null/empty input or a blacklist match. Called by UICustomRenderDispatch (00489fd0), sub_493060 (00493060), UIComboListRender (00495580) and sub_498440 (00498440).

local_names.v2: lookup result and default failure value (-1)
local_names.SrcStr: local 80-byte working copy of the input string

operations.description: v2 is initialized to -1 as the default (failure) result
If a2 is null the function returns -1 immediately
If strlen(a2) is 0 the body is skipped and the function returns -1 (empty input blocked)
The input string is copied into the local SrcStr buffer (80 bytes) with strcpy
sub_589901 normalizes SrcStr (lowercase / path-separator normalization) in place
StringArrayMatchSearch(SrcStr) checks the normalized string against a blocked-name array; a match returns -1 immediately
StringNormalizeLookup(SrcStr) looks the string up in a registered-key table, returning its index in v2 (0 means not registered)
Only when the lookup returned 0 (string is not a known registered key) does the function extract and store a component
sub_587C20(SrcStr, &word_5BEB48) locates the path-separator character; if found it is truncated to a null terminator in place
The extracted component is copied with strcpy into the per-instance name storage slot indexed by this[1349] (counter at this+0x1514), which is post-incremented
Return v2: the registered-key lookup index, or -1 for null/empty input, blacklist match, or an unregistered (newly stored) string
